benchmark_metadata.name: Varman YuNet Landmark Displacement Controlled Pilot

paired_displacement_comparison.preregistered_reading: Reading 3: Protected displacement is statistically larger than clean control (CI excludes zero: [0.4354, 1.5115]) and a meaningful fraction exceeds 2 px aligned-crop space (31.33% > 2px, 43.33% scale > 3%). The current jitter range (+/-2px, +/-3%) may be too narrow, justifying a future wider-jitter experiment [Hypothesis].
